verdict.rationale: Dependency tracking is a fair question for a work-management product, but the evidence pack has no first-party documentation of dependency links, cross-board dependencies, or launch-level dependency views. Risk spotting, cross-platform views, and GitHub PR linking are adjacent features and earn no credit. A community report that linking tickets is "really bad" and loses data has no vendor dependency claim to contradict, so it cannot create a dispute; it only weakens the case further.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can track cross-team dependencies to coordinate large launches
